study: Kepler-69 b single-source Q8-trained Q9-heldout recurring-dip forecast
prior_evidence: Original Kepler-69 b Q8 BLS benchmark in real_kepler_lightcurve.py
source: Original MAST Kepler PDCSAP_FLUX FITS; require SAP_QUALITY == 0; fixed 301-cadence median normalization
safeguards: Do not view Q9 brightness measurements before fixing Q8 period, epoch, duration and evaluation rule.
All predicted but insufficiently sampled windows counted as unusable and reported.
Do not retune to improve outcomes; no target/quarter substitution.
One known planet host is not survey-wide sensitivity, and repeated dips are not planet validation.
Catalog period is a post-analysis comparison, not a feature given to BLS.
If Q9 FITS is missing or unprocessable, report that rather than changing the cohort.
